reason: Student requests broader algorithm/data evidence and a deployed repository-backed bonus demo.
original_study_status: Frozen and preserved. Its 2025 dispatch holdout has already been examined; newly added model comparisons on it are supplementary post-hoc benchmarking, not a newly untouched final test. No original model is reselected from these scores.

independent_dataset.target: Final CHIRPS-v2 dekadal rainfall rfh, mm; tabular aggregated data, no image-processing application
independent_dataset.publication_latency_policy: Use rainfall no newer than six completed dekads before target (about two months). This conservatively precedes documented final-product publication mid-month after the observed month. Do not assume the most recently completed dekad has finalized observations. Historical vintages are not archived here, so final revisions remain a limitation.
forbidden_predictors: published climatology fields of uncertain reference period
independent_dataset.quality_policy: Keep only version=final, one row per district/date, nonnegative finite rfh; reindex on the 36-dekad calendar before lagging; do not interpolate targets or histories; retain extremes.
baselines: training-only median for each of 36 annual dekads
independent_dataset.development_target_embargo: Leave November–December immediately before each January validation/test origin out of training. Final-product publication is then safely earlier than the origin. The model is frozen through each evaluation window; only valid lagged inputs update.

selection: Unweighted mean fold MAE; every new nonlinear model gets six fixed configurations; standard comparators reuse original search definitions.
evaluation: MAE skill versus study-specific seasonal baseline
95% observation coverage and width for probabilistic models
negative predicted rainfall/interval frequency as a distribution-support limitation
interpretation: Report all results, not just the best dataset/model. Rainfall is an independent task with refitted models; it is not external validation of the trained electricity model. Different units must not be averaged into a cross-dataset raw-MAE ranking.

deployment.try_first: Azure App Service Linux Free F1

availability_review_correction: Before finalization, review found that late-year training targets were not all published by January forecast origins. Version 1.0 rainfall results are archived as invalid preliminary evidence, not reported as final scores. Version 1.1 applies a two-month (six-dekad) training embargo as well as delayed features. This correction follows availability evidence, not score optimization. Its already examined rainfall holdout is explicitly a corrected retrospective audit, not a newly untouched test.
